These are the final figures for the air pollution analysis

Setting up

Workspace:

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# Setting up the workspace 
if(Sys.getenv("RSTUDIO") == '1' & !knitr::is_html_output()) { # If using Rstudio and not rendering
  setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path))
} else if(Sys.getenv("RSTUDIO") != '1'){ # If using Rscript
  initial.options <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = FALSE)
  file.arg.name <- "--file="
  script.name <- sub(file.arg.name, "", initial.options[grep(file.arg.name, initial.options)])
  script.basename <- dirname(script.name)
  setwd(file.path(getwd(), script.basename))
}
```

Building the cohort and cleaning the covariates

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# Decide cancer of interest:
# This analysis is focused on breast cancer 
select_cancer <- "breast_cancer"

# set if cancer is first ever any cancer (YES) - no previous cancers of any type (except NMSC)
# or first of its type (NO) -there may be previous diagnosis of other cancer (except NMSC)
first_ever <- "YES"

source("GS_analysis/Script/Cohort_Build.R")


# Cleaning the data 
clean_covariates <- cleancovariates (base, data_realyears, data_carstairs, data_england)
complete_cohort <- cleanexposure(data_airpollution, clean_covariates)

complete_cohort <- complete_cohort %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(BMI)
  ) # Do not include those who have missing BMI
```

Analysis set up


```{r}
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# Time lag definitions

complete_cohort <- complete_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    meno_age_est = as.numeric(meno_age_est)
  )

complete_cohort_2lag <- complete_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    age_start365 = age_start365 + 730
  ) %>%
  filter(
    c_age365 > age_start365
  )

complete_cohort_5lag <- complete_cohort %>%
  mutate(
    age_start365 = age_start365 + 1825
  ) %>%
  filter(
    c_age365 > age_start365
  )

```


Full Cohort

```{r}
#| label: Full Cohort Analysis
#| warning: false
#| echo: false
source("GS_analysis/Script/TimeSplit_Menopause.R")
source("GS_analysis/Script/Point_Avg_CoxRegression.R")

# No Time lagS
all_results <- avg_nolag_clean %>%
  mutate(
    Subtype = case_when(
      Model == "C" ~ "Fully Adjusted", 
      TRUE ~ "ERROR"
    ), 
    Model = "Final_Model", 
    CI_upper = Upper_CI, 
    CI_lower = Lower_CI, 
    Pval = `p-value`, 
    Exposure = case_when(
      Variable == "PM2.5" ~ "PM 2.5", 
      Variable == "PM10" ~ "PM 10", 
      TRUE ~ "ERROR"
    ), 
    Wald_pval = NA_real_
  ) %>%
  select(Model, Subtype, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, Pval,Wald_pval, Exposure)
```


Subtypes
```{r}
#| label: Subtype Analysis
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

# Menopausal results

cohort_mensplit_nolag_changed <- cohort_mensplit %>%
  mutate(
    avgP25 = avgP25/5,
    avgP10 = avgP10/5,
    pointP25 = pointP25/5,
    pointP10 = pointP10/5
  )

source("GS_analysis/Script/Menopause_applied_avg_nolag.R")

# Using Lunn McNeil methods

source("GS_analysis/Script/LunnMcNeil.R")
source("GS_analysis/Script/LunnMcNeil_applied.R")

subtype <- rbind(all_results, lunnmcneil_results, all_men_results, all_carstairs) %>%
  mutate(
    Subtype = case_when(
      Subtype == "pos" ~ "Positive", 
      Subtype == "neg" ~ "Negative ", 
      Subtype == "unk" ~ "Unknown", 
      Subtype == "screen" ~ "Screen Detected", 
      Subtype == "interval" ~ "Interval Cancer", 
      Subtype == "other" ~ "Other", 
      Subtype == "invasive" ~ "Invasive Breast Cancer", 
      Subtype == "dcis" ~ "DCIS Breast Cancer",
      Subtype == "pre" ~ "Premenopausal", 
      Subtype == "post" ~ "Postmenopausal", 
      Subtype == "1 (most)" ~ "1 (most deprived)", 
      Subtype == "5 (least)" ~ "5 (least deprived)", 
      TRUE ~ Subtype
    ), 
    Model = case_when(
      Model == "Final_Model" ~ "Final Model", 
      Model == "ER_Status" ~ "ER Status", 
      Model == "Screen_Detected" ~ "Screen Detected*", 
      Model == "Invasive_DCIS" ~ "Invasive vs. DCIS", 
      Model == "Menopausal_Status" ~ "Menopausal Status", 
      TRUE ~ Model
    )
  )
```

Sensitivity Analysis
```{r}
#| label: Sensitivity Analysis
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

source("GS_analysis/Script/QuantifyingBias.R")
# PM10
beta   <- P10_C$coefficients["I(avgP10/5)"]
se     <- sqrt(vcov(P10_C)["I(avgP10/5)", "I(avgP10/5)"])
quantifybias_P10 <- measurementerror_quantification(beta, se) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = "PM 10"
  )

# PM2.5
beta   <- P25_C$coefficients["I(avgP25/5)"]
se     <- sqrt(vcov(P25_C)["I(avgP25/5)", "I(avgP25/5)"])
quantifybias_P25 <- measurementerror_quantification(beta, se)%>%
  mutate(
    Model = "PM 2.5"
  )

sensitivity_expansemodel <- rbind(quantifybias_P25, quantifybias_P10) %>%
  mutate(
    Covariate = "All", 
    `P-value` = NA_real_
  )

source("GS_analysis/Script/SensitivityAnalysis_DataClean.R")

sensitivity_all <- bind_rows(
  sensitivity_point$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_point$P25_sensitivity,
  
  sensitivity_2lag$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_2lag$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_5lag$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_5lag$P25_sensitivity,
  
  sensitivity_household$P10_sensitivity,sensitivity_household$P25_sensitivity,
  
  sensitivity_unadjusted$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_unadjusted$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_matchyear$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_matchyear$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_BMI$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_BMI$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_Carstairs$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_Carstairs$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_Smoking$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_Smoking$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_Alcohol$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_Alcohol$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_Educ$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_Educ$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_Parity$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_Parity$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_1Birth$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_1Birth$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_HRT$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_HRT$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_Meno$P10_sensitivity, sensitivity_Meno$P25_sensitivity, 
  sensitivity_expansemodel
  )


```



# Table 1: Data Description

```{r}
#| label: Table 1
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

nolag <- covariate(complete_cohort, bc_nolag) %>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Full Cohort"
  )
twolag <- covariate(complete_cohort, bc_2lag)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Sensitivity Cohort: 2 year time lag"
  )
fivelag <- covariate(complete_cohort, bc_5lag)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Sensitivity Cohort: 5 year time lag"
  )

outcome <- bind_rows(nolag) %>%
  mutate(
    Cases = case_when(
      Subcategories == 0 ~ 0, 
      TRUE ~ Cases
    ),
    `Rate per 1,000` = case_when(
      Subcategories == 0 ~ 0, 
      TRUE ~ `Rate per 1,000`
    ), 
    Subcategories = case_when(
      Subcategories == 1 ~ "Breast Cancer Case", 
      Subcategories == 0 ~ "Not Breast Cancer Case", 
      TRUE ~ "ERROR"
    )
  )
sensitivity <- bind_rows(twolag, fivelag) %>%
  mutate(
    Cases = case_when(
      Subcategories == 0 ~ 0, 
      TRUE ~ Cases
    ),
    `Rate per 1,000` = case_when(
      Subcategories == 0 ~ 0, 
      TRUE ~ `Rate per 1,000`
    ), 
    Subcategories = case_when(
      Subcategories == 1 ~ "Breast Cancer Case", 
      Subcategories == 0 ~ "Not Breast Cancer Case", 
      TRUE ~ "ERROR"
    )
  )
age <- covariate(complete_cohort, AgeEntry_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Age at study entry"
  )
yearofentry <- covariate(complete_cohort, matchyear_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Year of study entry"
  )

carstairs <- covariate(complete_cohort, Carstairs_quint)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Carstairs index"
  )
bmi <- covariate(complete_cohort, BMI_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Body Mass Index (BMI)"
  )
smoking <- covariate(complete_cohort, Smoking_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Smoking"
  )
alcohol <- covariate(complete_cohort, Alcohol_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Alcohol"
  )
education <- covariate(complete_cohort, Educ_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Highest attained education"
  )

parity <- covariate(complete_cohort, Parity_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Parity"
  )

agefirstbirth <- covariate(complete_cohort, Birth1_age_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Age at first birth"
  )
HRT <- covariate(complete_cohort, HRT_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Hormone replacement therapy (HRT)"
  )
meno <- covariate(cohort_mensplit, Menopause_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Menopause", 
    Subcategories = case_when(
      is.na(Subcategories) ~ "Unknown", 
      TRUE ~ Subcategories
    )
  )
ER <- covariate(complete_cohort, ER_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Oestrogen Receptor (ER) status"
  )

SCREEN <- covariate(complete_cohort, screen_detected_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Screen Detected"
  )

INVDCIS <- covariate(complete_cohort, inv_dcis_cat)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "Invasive or DCIS Breast Cancer"
  )

Region <- covariate(complete_cohort, Region)%>%
  mutate(
    covariate = "UK Country"
  )


table1 <- bind_rows(outcome,  meno, ER, INVDCIS, SCREEN,carstairs, Region, age, yearofentry, bmi, smoking, alcohol, education, parity, agefirstbirth, HRT, sensitivity) %>%
  mutate(
      Cases = paste0(format(Cases, big.mark = ",")),
      `Person Years` = paste0(format(`Person Years`, big.mark = ","))
  )

table1_tbl <- table1 %>%
    group_by(covariate) %>%
    gt(rowname_col = NULL) %>%
    # Center everything
    cols_align(
      align = "center",
      columns = everything()
    ) %>%
    # Bold the column headers
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = cells_column_labels()
    ) %>%
    # Style the group headers (time_lag)
    tab_style(
      style = list(
        cell_text(weight = "bold"),
        cell_fill(color = "lightgray"),
        cell_borders(sides = "top"),
        cell_borders(sides = "bottom")
      ),
      locations = cells_row_groups(groups = everything())
    ) %>%
    # Add title
    tab_header(
      title = "Table 1: Generations Study Cohort Data Description")
    

table1_tbl

```




# Figure 2: Primary and Subtype analysis in the Generations Study for PM2.5 (Panel A) and PM 10(Panel B) and Breast Cancer Incidence. 

All hazard ratios calculated per 5 ug/m3 of exposure. For Primary Analysis, Model A adjusted for year of entry into the study; Model B adjusted for A + individual (BMI, smoking, alcohol, education) and small level socioeconomic status (Carstairs Index); Model C adjusted for B + reproductive risk factors (parity, age at first birth, HRT, and menopausal status updated throughout follow up)


## Panel A : PM 2.5

```{r}
#| label: Figure 2 pan A
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 17
#| fig-height: 15
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

subtype_P25 <- subtype %>%
  filter(
    Exposure == "PM 2.5"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Subtype != "Unknown"
  ) %>%
  select(-Exposure)
subtype_P25_plot <- subtype_plot(subtype_P25,
         x_breaks = c(0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.2, 1.4, 1.6, 1.8, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0))

subtype_P25_plot +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = "* For women in England who are eligible for screening (Ages 50–71) only",
    theme = theme(
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0)
    )
  )
```

# Supplementary Table 3: Primary and subtype analysis in the Generations Study for PM2.5 and PM10 and breast cancer incidence. 

All hazard ratios calculated per 5 ug/m3 of exposure. For Primary Analysis, Model A adjusted for year of entry into the study; Model B adjusted for A + individual (BMI, smoking, alcohol, education) and small level socioeconomic status (Carstairs Index); Model C adjusted for B + reproductive risk factors (parity, age at first birth, HRT, and menopausal status updated throughout follow up)


```{r}
#| label: Supp Table 4 pan A
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 20
#| warning: false
#| echo: false

subtype_clean <- subtype%>%
  mutate(
    `HR (95% CI)` = sprintf(
      "%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", HR, CI_lower, CI_upper
    ), 
    Pval = round(Pval, 3), 
    Wald_pval = round(Wald_pval, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(Model, Subtype,`HR (95% CI)`, Pval, Wald_pval, Exposure) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Exposure,
    values_from = c(`HR (95% CI)`, Pval, Wald_pval)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    #Subtype != "Unknown"
  )

subtype_clean %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Model") %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Subtype Analysis"
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "PM 10",
    columns = c(`HR (95% CI)_PM 10`, `Pval_PM 10`, `Wald_pval_PM 10`)
  ) %>%
  tab_spanner(
    label = "PM 2.5",
    columns = c(`HR (95% CI)_PM 2.5`, `Pval_PM 2.5`, `Wald_pval_PM 2.5`)
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    `HR (95% CI)_PM 10` = "HR (95% CI)",
    `Pval_PM 10` = "P-value",
    `HR (95% CI)_PM 2.5` = "HR (95% CI)",
    `Pval_PM 2.5` = "P-value", 
    `Wald_pval_PM 2.5` = "Wald P-value", 
    `Wald_pval_PM 10` = "Wald P-value"
  )
```

## Proportional Hazards
```{r}
fullcohort <- proportionalhazards(complete_cohort, cohort_mensplit)
fullcohort %>%
separate(model, into = c("Pollutant", "Model"), sep = "_") %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Pollutant") %>%
  cols_label(Model = "Category")%>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Full Cohort Proportional Hazards"
  )

premen <- cohort_mensplit %>%
  filter(
    menobandf == "premenopausal"
  )
premen_ph <- proportionalhazards(premen, premen)
premen_ph %>%
separate(model, into = c("Pollutant", "Model"), sep = "_") %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Pollutant") %>%
  cols_label(Model = "Category")%>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Premenopausal Proportional Hazards"
  )

postmen <- cohort_mensplit %>%
  filter(
    menobandf == "postmenopausal"
  )
postmen_ph <- proportionalhazards(postmen, postmen)
postmen_ph %>%
separate(model, into = c("Pollutant", "Model"), sep = "_") %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Pollutant") %>%
  cols_label(Model = "Category")%>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Postmenopausal Proportional Hazards"
  )
```
